name: Dependency Audit
author: Thomas Vezirop (thomasvez)
description: Bar badge aggregating dependency security/staleness (CVEs, outdated packages) across your projects. Supports npm, pnpm, yarn, cargo, pip, Go, Ruby, and .NET — auto-detects each project's package manager (or finds projects on its own via discoverRoots) and shells out to its native audit tool: npm/pnpm/yarn audit, cargo-audit, pip-audit, govulncheck, bundler-audit, dotnet list package --vulnerable.

barWidget.description: CVE badge for npm/pnpm/yarn, cargo, pip, Go, Ruby & .NET projects
